title: load_project rsp
description: Response to cmd:load_project. Describes what cmd_load_project_ (backend/src/service_cmd_lifecycle.cpp) ACTUALLY emits: data carries a `status` of ok/partial/rejected. A clean load emits status:"ok" WITH empty param_warnings/instance_warnings arrays (they are always present, not omitted); a partial load fills those arrays with per-item reasons. The envelope `ok` mirrors `status`: ok => ok:true, partial/rejected => ok:false with an `error` string. The `status!=ok => ok==false` pairing is outside the constrained subset (no if/then) and is guarded by a consumer test (tools/xinsp2_py/tests/test_run_outcome.py).
